entities.name: UniProt Q31FF5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (261 aa) to reviewed Hydrogenovibrio crunogenus 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate hydroxymethyltransferase; EC 2.1.2.11.
Catalyzes transfer of a hydroxymethyl group from 5,10-methylene-THF to 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate, yielding ketopantoate; assigned to pantothenate biosynthesis.
Annotation reports Mg2+ binding, one ion per subunit, and cytoplasmic localization.
Reviewed annotation reports a homodecamer organized as a pentamer of dimers.

entities.name: Pantothenate biosynthesis
observations: Q31FF5 is annotated to pantothenate biosynthesis, forming the ketopantoate intermediate from 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate and 5,10-methylene-THF.
